title: SpaceX Quarterly Financial Report Reveals Surprising Turnaround: AI Computing Revenue Surges Three Times, Officially Surpassing Space Launch

content_html:
SpaceX's latest quarterly financial report shows that with the company's significant expansion in AI computing infrastructure, its AI department's revenue for a single quarter has increased to $2.6 billion, more than tripling year-over-year, successfully surpassing the space launch segment and becoming the core source of the company's business value. However, due to the dual impact of computing power expansion and investment in aerospace R&D, the company remains in a loss-making position overall.

The financial data shows that SpaceX's business is mainly divided into three segments: aerospace, artificial intelligence, and network connectivity primarily through Starlink. This quarter, the aerospace business generated $962 million in revenue, and SpaceX itself remains its largest customer for rocket launches; the Starlink network connectivity business contributed $4.2 billion in revenue, still the only segment that is currently profitable for the company.

Computing power leasing transactions drive growth, with Anthropic and Google both collaborating

The explosive growth of the AI business mainly stems from computing power leasing transactions. In May and June this year, SpaceX successively reached cooperation agreements with Anthropic and Google, providing AI computing power support, which directly made it compete with new computing cloud service providers such as CoreWeave.

Even though its Grok large model faced setbacks in development and market competition, the company quickly adjusted its business strategy by renting out computing power from its previously built data centers and planning to acquire the enterprise-level AI product company Cursor. From "building models itself" to "selling computing power to others," SpaceX's role shift on the AI track can be described as decisive.

Capital expenditure of $18.37 billion in a single quarter, with Starship R&D also increasing efforts

However, rapid expansion has also brought a heavy financial burden. The capital expenditure of SpaceX reached $18.37 billion in this quarter, with the AI department's loss reaching $1.5 billion in a single quarter. Musk stated at an investor meeting that the company is building large-scale AI computing centers at a speed exceeding its competitors and continuously optimizing related models.

R&D investment in the aerospace field increased by $389 million year-over-year, mainly focused on the development of the heavy-lift rocket Starship. At present, Starship development is crucial for deploying the next generation of heavy Starlink satellites. Only by increasing the payload capacity per launch can the profit scale of the network connectivity business be further expanded. Considering all aspects of business performance, SpaceX's net loss for this quarter has narrowed to $143 million, which is better than market expectations. However, given the huge investments in space data centers and the extensive computing power network, as well as the fluctuating stock price after hours, the market remains cautious about the company's high-tech roadmap—when the largest growth engine of a space company becomes AI computing power, Musk's story line may be undergoing a fundamental rewrite.

content_html_zh:
SpaceX最新季度财报显示，随着公司在AI计算基础设施方面的大幅扩张，其AI部门单季度营收增至26亿美元，同比增长逾三倍，成功超越航天发射领域，成为公司商业价值的核心来源。 但受算力扩张和航天研发投入的双重影响，公司整体仍处于亏损状态。

财务数据显示，SpaceX的业务主要分为三个部分：航空航天、人工智能以及主要通过星链进行的网络连接。 本季度，航空航天业务创造了 9.62 亿美元的收入，SpaceX 本身仍然是其火箭发射的最大客户； Starlink网络连接业务贡献了42亿美元的收入，仍然是该公司目前唯一盈利的部门。

Anthropic 与 Google 携手合作，算力租赁交易推动增长

人工智能业务的爆发式增长主要源于算力租赁交易。 今年5月和6月，SpaceX先后与Anthropic、谷歌达成合作协议，提供AI算力支持，这直接使其与CoreWeave等新型计算云服务商展开竞争。

尽管其Grok大型模型在开发和市场竞争中遭遇挫折，但该公司迅速调整了业务策略，将之前建设的数据中心的算力出租出去，并计划收购企业级人工智能产品公司Cursor。 从“自己构建模型”到“向他人出售算力”，SpaceX 在 AI 赛道上的角色转变可谓是决定性的。

单季度资本支出183.7亿美元，星舰研发也加大力度

然而，快速扩张也带来了沉重的财务负担。 SpaceX本季度资本支出达到183.7亿美元，AI部门单季度亏损达到15亿美元。 马斯克在投资者会议上表示，公司正在以超越竞争对手的速度建设大规模AI计算中心，并不断优化相关模型。

航空航天领域研发投入同比增加3.89亿美元，主要集中在重型火箭星舰的研发上。 目前，星舰的研制对于部署下一代重型星链卫星至关重要。 只有提高每次发射的有效载荷能力，才能进一步扩大网络连接业务的利润规模。 考虑到各方面的业务表现，SpaceX本季度净亏损已收窄至1.43亿美元，好于市场预期。 然而，考虑到航天数据中心的巨额投资和广泛的算力网络，以及盘后股价的波动，市场对该公司的高科技路线图仍持谨慎态度——当航天公司最大的增长引擎成为AI算力时，马斯克的故事情节可能正在经历根本性改写。
